Researcher in applied mathematics at Inria (Center at Université Grenoble Alpes)

Member of the Laboratoire Jean Kuntzmann and the AIRSEA team.

My work focuses primarily on numerical methods for partial differential equations, with applications to oceanic and atmospheric flows. I am also interested in scientific computing, particularly in developing mathematical formulations and numerical algorithms suited to different high-performance computing architectures.
